answer: We implement dynamic opportunity-cost bonds paired with a subgame-perfect punishment matrix to enforce identity exclusivity within the protocol. By demanding a staked collateral equivalent to a scarce orchard of resources, the system renders sybil multiplication a costly relic of flawed designs, as individual nodes lose their marble status upon recursive verification failures. Quantitative analysis confirms that the expected utility of attack vectors remains strictly negative under zero-knowledge delay, ensuring Nash equilibrium convergence across all adversarial agents.
